# Southern AG Carriers, Inc. Expands Regional Operations with New Terminal Facility in Albany.

September 18, 2026

 

ALBANY, Ga. — Southern AG Carriers, Inc. expanded its regional operations with the opening of a new terminal facility in Albany, Georgia. To celebrate this milestone, the company hosted a formal Open House and Ribbon Cutting ceremony on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 11:00 AM at 705 McCollum Drive.

"This new terminal represents much more than a new facility," said Lem Goodpasture, Chief Executive Officer at Southern AG Holdings, LLC. "It represents the continued growth of Southern AG Holdings and our commitment to the people and customers who have helped us get here. For more than 30 years, we've built this company on hard work, strong relationships and our roots in agriculture. This investment gives us the space and resources to better serve our customers, support our drivers and employees, and prepare Southern AG for the opportunities ahead. We're proud of where we've been, excited about where we're going, and committed to growing right here in Albany."

With over 35 years of industry experience, the expansion reinforced Southern AG Carriers' ongoing investment in Dougherty County and its long-standing commitment to enhancing regional transport infrastructure. As part of the project, the company made more than $300,000 in capital investment in its new Albany facility. Southern AG Carriers currently employs more than 185 people and plans to add 26 new jobs over the next four years. The new terminal supports expanded fleet logistics, increases regional service capacity, and provides enhanced operational resources to serve clients throughout Southwest Georgia and beyond.

"We are delighted that Southern AG, which has been a presence in our community for decades, has made the decision to remain in Albany and expand its operations,” said Mayor Bo Dorough. "This development will ensure Albany continues to serve as a regional hub for logistics and commerce. I want to thank and congratulate Southern AG for making this commitment to our community, as it continues to transport goods for local farmers, create jobs, and help sustain our national economy”.

Attendees at the event had the opportunity to participate in the formal ribbon-cutting ceremony, tour the state-of-the-art facility, and connect with company leaders alongside local civic officials.
